testData.description: A fictional demo pet and seven days of synthetic records. No real animal or household is represented.
testData.photoUsage: Every observation has its own distinct AI-generated illustration; no image is reused across observations. These pictures are not real camera captures or evidence.

traits: Often carries a rope toy to the caregiver
Stops to sniff on familiar walks
Often rests on the mat beside the sofa
fictionalProfile.routine: Two walks and two meals, with an afternoon mat-rest period and short indoor play.
fictionalProfile.healthContext: No medical history or diagnosis is asserted. Food amounts are fictional records, not feeding advice.

dailySummaries.context: Weekend: a longer morning park visit.
A visitor stopped by from 15:30 to 16:00.
Fictional rain scenario: the caregiver shortened both walks and added an indoor scent game.
Camera disconnected from 10:05 to 18:40; caregiver notes cover meals and walks, but afternoon rest is unknown.
The camera connection was restored; the caregiver confirmed the walk times.

dailyStories.title: A morning of little discoveries
dailyStories.body: Momo stopped to sniff leaves on the morning walk, rested on her mat in the afternoon, and walked again in the evening.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 390 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: A quiet spot by the window
dailyStories.body: Momo spent part of the afternoon lying by the sofa. A short rope-toy game and an evening walk were also recorded.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 410 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: The rope toy made an appearance
dailyStories.body: A longer park walk started the day. Later, Momo carried her rope toy to the caregiver and played indoors.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 330 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: A visitor and the usual dinner
dailyStories.body: Momo approached the visitor to sniff their shoes, then returned to her mat. Her two meals and both walks were recorded.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 360 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: A rainy-day change of plan
dailyStories.body: Both walks were shorter today. The caregiver also recorded a 25-minute indoor scent game. These records do not establish Momo’s mood.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 420 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: A few moments, with a gap
dailyStories.body: Caregiver notes describe both walks, meals, a short play session and evening brushing. Afternoon camera records are missing, so today’s story is incomplete.
dailyStories.sourceNote: Fictional caregiver notes and 145 minutes of camera availability. Photos are AI-generated illustrations, not event evidence.

dailyStories.title: Back along the evening path
dailyStories.body: Momo walked along the park connector at dusk. Earlier records include breakfast, a mat-rest period and a short game with her rope toy.
